title: A Slow-Time Receiver Interface for Turbulent Free-Space Quantum Polarization Links
summary: Atmospheric turbulence makes free-space quantum polarization links intrinsically time varying, whereas receiver-side reduced interfaces are often treated as static. This paper develops a slow-time receiver interface by extending an aperture-conditioned static model to the temporal domain. The receiver-plane phase field, beam-centroid displacement, and scintillation are modeled as hidden slow-time stochastic processes, from which the reduced interface is generated at each instant.
